| Command | Description | Example |
|---------|-------------|---------|
| `task add <title>` | Add a new task | `task add "Read book" -p low -d 2024-12-25` |
| `task list` | Show all tasks | `task list` |
| `task done <id>` | Mark task as complete | `task done 1` |
| `task delete <id>` | Remove a task | `task delete 2` |
| `task search <keyword>` | Find tasks by keyword | `task search "urgent"` |

### Options for `task add`

- `-p, --priority`: Set priority (`low`, `medium`, `high`). Default: `medium`
- `-d, --due`: Set due date in YYYY-MM-DD format
